calendar.deleteConfirmMessage: The event “{{title}}” will be permanently deleted.

myHours.title: My hours
myHours.description: Where two groups' lessons overlap, pick once which hour is yours. The choice applies to every week; unselected lessons are not synced and not shown.
myHours.hint: Some lessons still overlap — pick yours.

grades.title: Grades
grades.phase4Description: Grades by subject, subject averages and the overall average arrive in Phase 4.

easistent.title: eAsistent
easistent.description: Pulls the timetable, homework and announced tests from eAsistent. Data is stored on this device only.
easistent.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.

errors.missingCredentials: Enter and save your eAsistent login first.
errors.network: Connection failed. In a browser/PWA the eAsistent API is blocked by CORS — sync in the Android app.

easistent.backgroundSyncHint: Daily automatic updates via Android (WorkManager), even when the app is closed. Failures surface on the next app open.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.description: Pulls events from your Google Calendar into the app. Data is stored on this device only.
google.clientIdHint: Already built into the released app — just press Connect. Enter your own client ID only to override it (docs/google-oauth-setup.md).
google.connectCancelled: Connection cancelled or timed out — try again.
google.disconnectConfirmMessage: The stored connection and all synced Google events are removed from this device. Your Google account is not touched.

errors.missingClientId: Enter your Google client ID first.
errors.missingCredentials: Google account is not connected — press Connect first.
errors.auth: Google rejected the connection. Disconnect, then connect again.
errors.http: Google Calendar API returned an error.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while syncing Google Calendar.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupDescription: Export all data to a single JSON file. Importing replaces all data in the app. The eAsistent password is never included — re-enter it after importing.
settings.importConfirmMessage: This will replace ALL data in the app with the file's contents. This cannot be undone.

backupErrors.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
backupErrors.notAnObject: The file content is not a valid backup.
backupErrors.missingAppVersion: The app version is missing in the file.
backupErrors.invalidSchemaVersion: A valid schema version is missing in the file.
backupErrors.schemaVersionMismatch: The schema version does not match the current app.
backupErrors.missingExportedAt: The export date is missing in the file.
backupErrors.missingData: The data section is missing in the file.
backupErrors.invalidTable: Table “{{table}}” in the file is invalid.

deviceCalendar.title: Calendar
deviceCalendar.description: Writes eAsistent data (lessons, tests, homework) into a calendar on this device — works with Fossify/DAVx⁵ and any Android calendar, no Google account.
deviceCalendar.webOnly: Writing to the device calendar is only available in the Android app.
deviceCalendar.noCalendars: No writable calendar exists on this device.
deviceCalendar.created: The Avtoplaner calendar was created and selected.
deviceCalendar.removeConfirmMessage: Every entry written by Avtoplaner will be removed from the device's calendars.
deviceCalendar.permissionDenied: Calendar access denied. Enable it in Settings → Apps → Avtoplaner → Permissions → Calendar.
